content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis missing hypothesis test for non-inferiority or superiority",
      "quote": "The pCR rate per independent central pathology review along with 95% exact confidence interval will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint analysis only describes confidence interval calculation, but the statistical hypothesis section states a null hypothesis of pCR rate = 25% and alternative pCR rate ≠ 25%. The analysis section does not mention performing a formal hypothesis test (e.g., exact binomial test) or how the confidence interval relates to the hypothesis testing.",
      "fix": "Add explicit description of the hypothesis test (e.g., exact binomial test) and how the p-value will be computed, or clarify that the confidence interval will be used for inference."
    },
    {
      "title": "Secondary endpoints mPR per central review and pCR per local review lack analysis description",
      "quote": "mPR rate per local pathology review, and ORR prior to surgery per investigator assessment, along with 95% exact confidence intervals, will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoints include mPR rate per independent central pathology review and pCR rate per local pathology review (as listed in Section 2.2), but the analysis section only mentions mPR per local review and ORR per investigator. The analysis for mPR per central review and pCR per local review is missing.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for mPR rate per central review and pCR rate per local review, including confidence interval calculation."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is pCR rate assessed by independent central pathology review.",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint definition lacks a complete estimand: it does not specify the population (e.g., all enrolled patients or those who undergo surgery), the intercurrent events (e.g., how to handle patients who do not undergo surgery or die before surgery), and the summary measure (e.g., proportion with pCR). The analysis sets section says FAS includes all enrolled patients, but the estimand is not fully described.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint including population, variable, intercurrent events strategy (e.g., treatment policy, composite), and summary measure."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The pCR rate per independent central pathology review along with 95% exact confidence interval will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The statistical section does not describe how missing pCR data will be handled. For example, if a patient does not undergo surgery, how is pCR imputed or handled? This is critical for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Specify the handling of missing pCR data, including sensitivity analyses if needed."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size calculation lacks justification for assumptions",
      "quote": "Seventy-two (72) patients will be required to provide 80% power to reject a null hypothesis of a pCR rate of 25% at a 2-sided significance level of 0.05 if the true pCR rate is 44%.",
      "page": 72,
      "section": "11.1",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The sample size section provides the numbers but does not justify the assumed true pCR rate of 44% or the null rate of 25%. It also does not mention any adjustment for dropouts or patients who may not undergo surgery, which could affect the power.",
      "fix": "Add justification for the assumed pCR rates and include a discussion of expected dropout or non-evaluable rates and how they are accounted for in the sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistency in secondary endpoints list between objectives and endpoints sections",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are: • Event free survival (EFS) • Disease free survival (DFS) • Overall survival (OS) • Safety and tolerability ... • Change in surgical plan ... • Change in post-surgical management plan",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The secondary objectives (Section 2.2) include mPR rate per central review, pCR rate and mPR rate per local review, and ORR prior to surgery, but the secondary endpoints list (Section 4.2) omits these response endpoints. This inconsistency may lead to ambiguity about which endpoints are secondary.",
      "fix": "Align the secondary endpoints list with the secondary objectives, including all response endpoints."
    },
    {
      "title": "Exploratory endpoints lack analysis methods",
      "quote": "Patterns of failure in patients with local, regional, or distant disease recurrence as measured by descriptive statistics",
      "page": 26,
      "section": "4.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoints section lists endpoints but the statistical methods section (11.5.8) only mentions biomarker data analysis. There is no analysis description for patterns of failure, cost implications, immunogenicity, or quality of life endpoints.",
      "fix": "Add analysis methods for each exploratory endpoint, or state that they will be described in the SAP."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity control for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "mPR rate per local pathology review, and ORR prior to surgery per investigator assessment, along with 95% exact confidence intervals, will be calculated using Clopper-Pearson method",
      "page": 74,
      "section": "11.5.3.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any multiplicity adjustment for the multiple secondary endpoints (e.g., EFS, DFS, OS, response endpoints). Without a hierarchical testing procedure or other control, the type I error may be inflated.",
      "fix": "Specify a multiplicity control strategy for secondary endpoints, such as a hierarchical testing order or a gatekeeping procedure."
    }
  ]
}
